In this session, Rohith K Bobby walks through the practical challenges of taking AI from prototype to production, with a focus on real-time use cases.

The talk covers system architecture, model serving strategies, data pipelines, monitoring, and performance optimization, along with common pitfalls teams face when deploying AI at scale.
